name: architect
wording: the operator's principal, holding the meaning of the bounded contexts it is given: receives the operator's intent, hands user stories to the lead, accepts each story done on its outcome
reason: A delivered agent's values have one source, the canon that composes it; the workflow keeps only the architect's place among the parties. Brooks's keeper of conceptual integrity is what the name already says; holding several contexts unmerged is a fact about bounded contexts.
